title: Trump, Xi and Putin Meet: What We Know
description:
Trump, Xi and Putin held their first-ever three-way meeting in Shenzhen at the APEC summit, discussing Ukraine, Iran and nuclear weapons. No joint deal had been announced at the time of recording.
